quest_instance_schema.title: string
quest_instance_schema.claim_event_id: idempotent reward transaction ID or null

rules: Only actual events can advance objectives; no automatic success from prose alone.
Quest reward and penalties are applied once using claim_event_id.
Failure, expiration and refusal do not necessarily block follow-up story.
NPC individual goals, affection and registration/duty can gate acceptance and requests.
Quest progress can be updated by action in existing world, dungeon, trade or combat systems.
Create quests on demand; seed templates are examples, not mandatory repeating scripts.
